topic: Lifestyle creep: when income goes up, spending quietly goes up too.

episode.title: Lifestyle Creep: Where Did That Raise Go?

shots.narration: Bigger income, but the same money left? Meet lifestyle creep.
shots.scene: Bright 3D city flat, vertical composition, two identical small coin stacks on a clean table, no text or markings.
shots.action: Kash raises her empty palms beside the matching stacks.
shots.mood: Curious confusion, raised eyebrows, cheerful warm lighting.

shots.narration: For example, Kash earns one hundred and spends fifty.
shots.scene: Modern flat table with two equal stacks of plain gold tokens, a small cup nearby, no text or markings.
shots.action: Kash slides one stack toward the cup.
shots.mood: Simple and comfortable, soft daylight, uncluttered composition.

shots.narration: [excited] Then her example income rises to two hundred.
shots.scene: Same flat table, four equal stacks of plain gold tokens arranged beside Kash's unmarked notebook, no text.
shots.action: Kash lifts both hands in celebration over the four stacks.
shots.mood: Delighted surprise, bright gold highlights, friendly rounded shapes.

shots.narration: Suddenly, her usual cafe stop gets a little bigger.
shots.scene: Clean modern cafe table with a small plain cup beside a larger cup and pastry plate, no menus, logos or text.
shots.action: Kash pulls the larger cup and pastry plate toward herself.
shots.mood: Tempting and cozy, warm pastry colours, pleased expression.

shots.narration: Now her example spending reaches one hundred fifty.
shots.scene: Cafe table with four equal token stacks, three beside the large cup and pastry plate, one beside Kash, no markings.
shots.action: Coin points at the three stacks beside the cafe order.
shots.mood: Gentle realization, Kash's smile turning thoughtful.

shots.narration: [surprised] Her spending quietly climbed alongside her income.
shots.scene: Bright flat with two floating, unmarked pairs of coin columns: one pair shorter, the other taller, no text.
shots.action: Coin traces an upward path between the shorter and taller pairs.
shots.mood: Clear discovery, bright friendly colours, attentive expressions.

shots.narration: She still has fifty left, just like before.
shots.scene: Flat table with two identical leftover token stacks side by side, plain cafe cups behind them, no text.
shots.action: Kash aligns the two leftover stacks.
shots.mood: Calm understanding, matching gold shapes, reassuring soft light.

shots.narration: Today, compare your spending before and after an income increase.
shots.scene: Flat table with a small cup and a larger cafe order on opposite sides, plain tokens beside each, no text.
shots.action: Kash compares the two spending piles with her hands.
shots.mood: Practical and encouraging, relaxed posture, sunny room.

shots.narration: [whispers] Next: spot spending creep before your next purchase.
shots.scene: Modern cafe table with a small plain cup and an oversized pastry plate, vertical framing, no signs or lettering.
shots.action: Coin holds up one tiny hand between Kash and the pastry plate.
shots.mood: Playfully suspenseful, curious smiles, inviting golden light.

episode.endHook: Next: spot spending creep before your next purchase.
episode.description: Coin helps Kash spot lifestyle creep: spending quietly rising alongside income. Follow a simple example, then compare your own spending before and after an income increase. General money education, not personal financial advice.
